panels.title: Deterministic capacity across networks
panels.description: Latest deterministic run per network and condition. lambda is installed PV per unit of nominal load (balanced networks) or kWp per customer (three-phase feeders): compare MW across networks, lambda only within a network.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''))
         network, method, run_timestamp, raw_value,
         raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework' AS framework,
         coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced') AS phase_model
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method IN ('deterministic', 'stochastic') AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
           coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT network, raw_value->'params'->>'network_country' AS country, phase_model, round((raw_value->>'source_vm_pu')::numeric, 3) AS source_vm_pu, raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv' AS existing_pv, raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale' AS load_scale, round((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric, 3) AS lambda_max, coalesce(raw_value->>'lambda_unit', 'per_unit_of_nominal_load') AS lambda_unit, round((raw_value->>'total_pv_mw')::numeric, 3) AS total_pv_mw, raw_value->>'binding_constraint' AS binding_constraint FROM d WHERE method = 'deterministic' AND framework = '$framework' ORDER BY network, phase_model

panels.title: What limits each network (binding constraint type)
panels.description: Across all frameworks. Under PRODIST (1.05 pu) overvoltage tends to bind; under EN 50160 (1.10 pu) the transformer does.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''))
         network, method, run_timestamp, raw_value,
         raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework' AS framework,
         coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced') AS phase_model
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method IN ('deterministic', 'stochastic') AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
           coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT framework, split_part(raw_value->>'binding_constraint', '@', 1) AS constraint_type, count(DISTINCT network) AS networks, string_agg(DISTINCT network, ', ') AS which FROM d WHERE method = 'deterministic' AND raw_value->>'binding_constraint' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

panels.title: Effect of unbalance (three-phase feeders)
panels.description: Same three-phase solver; balanced_equivalent spreads every load and PV evenly over the phases. A positive overestimate means the balanced model reports more room than exists.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''))
         network, method, run_timestamp, raw_value,
         raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework' AS framework,
         coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced') AS phase_model
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method IN ('deterministic', 'stochastic') AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
           coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT network, framework, round((raw_value->>'source_vm_pu')::numeric, 3) AS source_vm_pu, round(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE phase_model = 'unbalanced'), 2) AS unbalanced_kwp, round(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE phase_model = 'balanced_equivalent'), 2) AS balanced_equivalent_kwp, round(100 * (max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE phase_model = 'balanced_equivalent') / nullif(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE phase_model = 'unbalanced'), 0) - 1), 1) AS balanced_overestimate_pct, round(max((raw_value->>'max_vuf_percent')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE phase_model = 'unbalanced'), 2) AS max_vuf_pct FROM d WHERE method = 'deterministic' AND raw_value ? 'phase_model' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
                      coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''))
         network, method, run_timestamp, raw_value,
         raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework' AS framework,
         coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced') AS phase_model
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method IN ('deterministic', 'stochastic') AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY network, method, raw_value->'conditions'->>'framework',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'phase_model', 'balanced'),
           coalesce(raw_value->>'source_vm_pu', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'params'->>'existing_pv', ''),
           coalesce(raw_value->'conditions'->>'load_scale', ''),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT network || CASE WHEN phase_model <> 'balanced' THEN ' / ' || phase_model ELSE '' END AS label, (raw_value->>'total_pv_mw')::float AS mw FROM d WHERE method = 'deterministic' AND framework = '$framework' AND raw_value->>'total_pv_mw' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2 DESC
